article.title: 湯森路透自建大型語言模型，投入4,000萬美元降低AI成本與外部模型依賴
article.summary: 湯森路透（Thomson Reuters）推出首款自研大型語言模型Thomson。湯森路透是一家提供法律、稅務、會計與新聞等專業資訊服務的內容與科技公司，旗下包括Reuters新聞業務。該公司投入約4,000萬美元訓練Thomson，費用包含人才與運算資源。

article.title: The next flagship Snapdragon will be the first 5GHz smartphone chip, and here’s why you should care
article.summary: Credit: Robert Triggs / Android Authority TL;DR Qualcomm has announced the first details for its next-generation Snapdragon flagship processor. The new processor has a 5GHz CPU, making it the first smartphone CPU to reach this milestone. A new “FlexCache” architecture also delivers more performance improvements. Qualcomm has teased the arrival of two Snapdragon 8 Elite series chips at its Snapdragon Summit next month. Now, the company has revealed the first details about its new silicon, and it might have an impressive CPU. Qualcomm has officially detailed the CPU for its next-generation Snapdragon processor, and this is the first smartphone CPU to reach 5GHz. That’s an impressive achievement on paper and comes after the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy reached a peak speed of 4.74GHz.

article.title: OpenAI’s Jalapeño chip is built for fast inference at scale, benchmarks show
article.summary: Tested on Semianalysis’s InferenceX benchmark, Jalapeño registered both more tokens per user and more throughput per kilowatt than the currently available state-of-the art.
